Delhi Authorities Destroy Unsafe Food Ahead of Festivals

Ahead of the festive season, Delhi authorities have intensified food safety inspections and destroyed over 2,800 kg of unsafe food products. The operation included the destruction of approximately 150 kg of paneer and 10 kg of khoya. Inspections were conducted in areas including Khoya Mandi, Mori Gate, and Janakpuri. Reports indicated the presence of detergent in some paneer samples.
